_comment: Starter channel list for the on-call-report skill. Copy this file to channels.json (or point ONCALL_CHANNELS_FILE at your own copy) and replace every name and id with channels from your Slack workspace. Ids here are placeholders, not real Slack ids. Do not commit a filled-in channels.json to a public repository.

_schema.tiers[].tier: 0-4; the skill scans tiers in ascending order and treats each tier as described in SKILL.md
_schema.tiers[].channels[].name: Slack channel name with the leading #, for display in the report
_schema.tiers[].channels[].id: Slack channel id, used for mcp__slack__slack_read_channel
_schema.tiers[].channels[].signal: One line on what shows up in the channel; drives the 'Signal Type' column
_schema.tiers[].channels[].category: Frontend | Backend | Infra | Customer Impact | Leadership | Product | All (All/Leadership channels are categorized per item)
_schema.tiers[].channels[].role: Tier 0 only: triage | team | team-oncall | demo | leadership. The report template's {leadership_channel} and {demo_channel} resolve to the channels with those roles

tiers.name: Always-Monitor
tiers.scan: every run, first; summarized separately as the Your Pulse section

channels.name: #eng-frontend-oncall
channels.signal: Frontend bug reports, Sentry alerts, user-reported issues

channels.name: #eng-backend-oncall
channels.signal: Backend/infra on-call: cloud alerts, dashboards, ingestion

channels.name: #sales-demo-help
channels.signal: Demo environment issues, sales demo blockers

channels.name: #alerts-web
channels.signal: Sentry auto-alerts for the web app

channels.name: #alerts-admin
channels.signal: Sentry auto-alerts for the admin app

channels.name: #alerts-jobs
channels.signal: Background job and scheduled task failures

channels.name: #support
channels.signal: General support requests and support-tool notifications

channels.name: #product-feedback
channels.signal: CS team product feedback and UX issues

channels.name: #demo-feedback
channels.signal: Demo feedback from sales/CS, UX gaps exposed in demos

tiers.name: Contextual
tiers.scan: only when a Tier 0-3 item references them
